items.title: Mets prospect Mitch Voit is so polished X decides he must be AI
items.summary: A routine SNY clip of the 21-year-old accepting a Mets player-development award went viral as X insisted he looked AI-generated, "like an AI generated Disney prince." He is very much real, and hit .273 this season.
items.author: @SNY_Mets
